caption: Stance distribution among records published January to April 2026 (descriptive only).
notes: January-April 2026 records with a valid stance (n=2689), classified with the same v1 prompt. These records are outside the 2021-2025 analytic window; they are reported descriptively and enter no trend statistic, figure or model. 95% percentile bootstrap CIs (1000 resamples, seed 42), resampling 2026 records only. Critical stance was Alarm or Caution. Favourable stance was Cautious Optimism or Advocacy.
